source_text: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΕΝ ΠΝΕΥΜΑΤΙ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΗΘΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΚΥΝΗΣΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΑΤΡΕΙΑΣ ΛΟΓΟΣ ΕΝΝΑΤΟΣ. Περὶ τῆς ἁγίας σκηνῆς, ὅτι τύπος ἦν τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἐκκλησίας. Ἀγάπης μὲν οὖν εἰς Θεόν τε καὶ ἀδελφοὺς περιφανῆ τὰ αὐχήματα, καὶ ἀποπεραίνεται μὲν δι' ἀμφοῖν
pass_a_gloss: ON ADORATION… BOOK NINE. Peri tēs hagias skēnēs / Concerning the holy tent, that it was typos / a type of the Ekklēsias / Church en Christō / in Christ. Agapēs / love unto Theon / God and adelphous / brothers…
pass_b_english: ON ADORATION AND WORSHIP IN SPIRIT AND TRUTH — BOOK NINE. Concerning the holy tent, that it was a type of the Church in Christ. So then the boasts of love unto God and unto brothers are conspicuous, and the law is finished through both

anf_compare.notes: No PD complete English of Cyril De adoratione Book 9. Sense from PG 68 Greek lock. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.
